notes: bundleSha256 is the main binary SHA-256 (Contents/MacOS/Emdash), the value gates.ts compares with installed binarySha256.

userData is appData/emdash, which is ~/Library/Application Support/emdash (applyIdentity in index-D75PbGY3.js, USER_DATA_DIR_NAME emdash in boot-guard). The databases sit there: emdash4.db (current), emdash3.db, emdash.db, conversations.db, workspace-registry.db, pull-requests.db, mementos.db (index-DsWXTM2W.js). The folder is not on disk yet on this account.

Worktrees and the projects folder default to ~/emdash/worktrees and ~/emdash/repositories (index-DsWXTM2W.js). The adapter's old dataDirs entry (~/emdash/worktrees) was a worktree root, not the database folder.
login.kind is agent-cli: Emdash's own sign-in is optional (onboarding has a Skip for now button), and it runs the account's claude and codex CLIs in node-pty.

autoApprove is a provider preference (ptyPreferenceSchema, default false, index-DsWXTM2W.js) stored in the app, not in a settings file, so it is a GUI setting. ADES 3.9 wants it on. Without it, approval prompts block unattended runs.

Launch-time writes: Claude hooks go to settings.json under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude, and Codex hooks to config.toml (agents-gIvWhVSs.js). Skills go to .agentskills inside the project, and only on explicit install or create (runtimes-agent-config-node-CfzT-wi7.js). Skills are not global. Hook timing (launch or first thread) was not verified.

Telemetry: boot-guard reads telemetryEnabled (default true unless the value is false, 0 or no); no envPrefix is set, so the env name is the raw key. A stored userOptOut flag also exists. Opt-out is a GUI item. Auto-update: a 60-minute check interval and a 30-second startup delay (update-service-CKQ1sk2P.js). Whether downloads install automatically was not confirmed.

orchestrationTrigger null matches ADES 3.9 (orchestration not supported). No launch agent label appears in the bundle, so launchAgents is empty. The helper executables match the bundle names (Contents/Frameworks).

Repair 2026-11-06 on 1.2.10 (1.2.11 is offered in Settings and by the sidebar Update button; declined). First-run, Open project, modal and composer positions were read on the real window and did not move.

Workspace mode (checked): a default task runs in ~/emdash/worktrees/<project>-<hash>/<project>-<task>-<id>. Track B (shared.ts) and Track C look for the session log by cwd equal to ctx.worktree, so B1 and B3 had 'no session log', and a task never changes files in the arena. emdash.ts newThread now picks 'Use the repository directory' in Workspace Settings, so the agent runs in ~/arena/emdash, its log is in -Users-ademark-arena-emdash, and waitDone cwd is worktree. Two tasks in the same folder work. DEVIATION to record: Emdash's default is a new worktree per task, and A4 and Tracks B and C now skip that worktree creation. ADES 3.9's check 'the worktree exists under ~/emdash/worktrees' no longer applies, and TESTS Track C allows 'a local worktree or checkout'. A3 still times only cmd+n and the prompt click, as in the default mode, and creates no task.

Settings 'Create branch and worktree by default' does not choose the repository directory: off only moves the modal from 'Create new branch' to 'Checkout branch'. The renderer's defaultPreset gives repo-root only for an unborn or non-git project. No setting or JSON key does it, so the choice is made per task.

Telemetry: Settings > General > Privacy & Telemetry stores kv telemetry:enabled in emdash4.db. emdash.ts clicks the switch once after each reset (it was on before this repair, against the ADES 3.9 pin). The switch point assumes the 'An update is available' card is shown; it was there on fresh data within 15 s. Settings search does not filter the page. Check with: select value from kv where key='telemetry:enabled'.

Quit: with an agent session alive, quit shows 'Quit Emdash? N running agent sessions may be stopped' with Cancel focused. Return cancels (checked), which is the old A1/A2/A9 quit failure; cmd+enter is Quit (checked). emdash.ts quit and reset press cmd+q then cmd+enter.
The git origin steps of openProject stay: they are what a default worktree task needs, and the repository directory mode does not push.

Launch (checked): Emdash keeps no window bounds, so every launch opens at 1400 x 900 and timed.launch does not resize it. It reopens the last view, the last task's Claude Code TUI with the prompt focused. launchComposerRect is in that 1400 x 900 window: probe-region found the text at 344,809,78,15 with no focus click. composerRect is the modal's prompt box, so A1 and A2 timed out while the probe text filled the TUI. Harness note: this rect breaks CALIBRATE rule 5 on purpose, because the launch window is not 1600 x 1000.

A11 builds the short thread and then the long one, so row 1 (150,132) is long and row 2 (150,164) is short. A4 repair 2026-11-06 on 1.2.10 (checked on the real window; positions did not move): reps 2-4 of the control run were false first words. The Create Task modal opens over the last task, so the watch read the previous rep's LEDGERMARK in the thread rect in the first frames after t0 (2-3 frames), and the replay log was read before the request came (it came about 600 ms later). The next rep then started while the task was opening, so cmd+n was lost and rep 3 typed into the TUI. emdash.ts newThread now clicks the project row (75,100) twice first: the project page lists task names only, and the modal keeps its positions there. Twice because A3 leaves its modal open, and with a modal open a row click only closes it (checked). Smoke gates run one rep per test, so a gate cannot show this; it needs two A4 reps in a row.

waitDone repair 2026-11-06 (checked): all tasks share ~/arena/emdash, so the default waitDone took the end of turn of an A10 stream (session 4813e230, replay:stream-3) as the end of the long A11 thread. A11 setup started 33 s before the last long-2000 request, the thread was still at step 489, and 'open' timed out; the earlier gates passed only because they started 15 s before it, and their 15 s 'open' was the agent still working. emdash.ts now waits, after a task's first send, for a log born after that send.

If cmd+n fails, the probe goes to the old composer at y 921, and the Claude Code TUI shows no typed text in its transcript before Enter, so nothing is ever read in this region.

A3 timed.newThread keeps its wait of 800 ms and the click on the prompt box (770,573), checked 2026-11-10 on the same video. The modal opens with the caret in the task name field (giant-deer-own, frames at 0.18 and 0.4 s), so without the click the probe types the task name.
